generate-fixtures.//: Regenerates the synthetic walks and traces under src/__fixtures__ and their expected.json (recorder plans 0001 and 0002). Never edit the output by hand: this script is the only thing allowed to write it.

cut-tracking-fixture.//: Cuts src/__fixtures__/tracking/el-jamon-2.tracking.json out of the second El Jamón walk (recorder plan 0003). Pass the walk file with --args. The walk itself is never committed.
